## What this does

Makes the toolchain identical in local and CI runs and makes CI fail on drift.

- **Node/npm pinned:** `web/.nvmrc` = `24.21.0` (exact Node 24 LTS — the lowest
  line every lockfile engine admits; license-checker-rseidelsohn 5.0.1 needs
  node ≥ 24 / npm ≥ 11), `web/package.json` engines `>=24 <25` / `>=11 <12`,
  `packageManager: npm@11.21.0`, `web/.npmrc` `engine-strict=true`. Every
  `setup-node` step resolves `node-version-file: web/.nvmrc`; every node-using
  job installs the `packageManager` npm and prints `node -v` / `npm -v`.
- **Lockfile truth:** `web/package-lock.json` regenerated exactly once under
  Node 24.21.0 + npm 11.21.0 (git blob `9a547e60b70ec2b3f2255167cbef9a0719bb9c2e`,
  byte-stable on re-run); the composed and web jobs run
  `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` +
  `git diff --exit-code web/package-lock.json` so a lockfile the pinned npm
  would write differently fails at PR time. `npm ci` only — a test refuses
  bare `npm install` dependency installs.
- **uv pinned:** `[tool.uv] required-version = "==0.12.6"`; `setup-uv` installs
  `0.12.6` in every workflow.
- **Runner/actions:** every job keeps `ubuntu-24.04`; actions bumped to the
  Node-24 majors (`checkout@v7`, `setup-node@v7`, `upload-artifact@v7`,
  `setup-uv@v10.2.0`).
- **Pipefail everywhere:** `defaults: run: shell: bash` at workflow level in all
  five workflows — `nightly`'s `| tee` stages now report real outcomes (NEW-3);
  a `tmp_path` mutation test proves `false | tee x` fails under `-eo pipefail`.
- **Runs that must complete (CF-01):** `cancel-in-progress` is
  `${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}` — superseded PR runs cancel,
  push-to-`main` runs never do; the scheduled/dispatch workflows set it `false`
  so a started sweep completes. The `docs` job now runs on pushes to `main`:
  the history guard judges the landed head's first-parent diff and the trailer
  check the push's commits — a change cannot dodge the guards by merging.
  `test_ci_docs_job_runs_only_on_pull_requests` was rewritten to the new policy
  in this PR, per ADR-151.
- **`make ci-local`:** a real five-job local mirror (the `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`
  suite, `docs-check` + history/trailer range checks, the scans, composed
  `tests/e2e` with web deps, the web check + perf); a parity test maps every
  `run:` command in `ci.yml` to it. The Makefile's stale "whatever CI runs,
  `make check` runs" claim is corrected — `check` is the python job.
- **Deferral:** `D-P34.1-1` (OPEN, cites BL-084) — "0 cancelled push runs on
  `main` after merges" is owed to the operator's first merge (OP-08); P38.1
  audits it; never claimed here. Migration anchor `D-P34.1-1:e0` recorded.
